Credential.title: WebAuthn Credential Mapping
Credential.description: Hardware WebAuthn registration mapping tying authenticators to user IDs and storing wrapping keys.

public_key.description: Base64 or Hex DER-encoded public key

wrapped_mek.description: Hex representation of AES-GCM encrypted Master Encryption Key (MEK)

Profile.title: User Public Profile
Profile.description: Public account records for discoverability and secure X25519 key agreements.

identity_pubkey.description: Hex string representing user public identity coordinate (X25519)

Chat.title: Chat Session Thread
Chat.description: Data record of the shared direct message mapping or group threads.

id.description: Chat UUID or compound ID (matches document ID)

is_group.description: Flag indicating if this chat is a multi-user group chat

participants.description: List of user IDs participating in the conversation

Message.title: Encrypted Message Frame
Message.description: Encrypted message payload including payload types and public cryptographic keys.

payload.description: Encrypted message body payload prefixed by binary flags

ephemeral_pubkey.description: Ephemeral sender public coordinate used in DH key rotation

/credentials/{credential_id}.description: Collection storing credential mapping registers used to verify auth attempts

/chats/{chat_id}.description: Active chatting rooms mapped over Firestore

/chats/{chat_id}/messages/{message_id}.description: E2EE encrypted communication envelopes for chats
